newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton trading is mixed, sellers shy.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton trading is mixed, sellers shy.

text.p: European raw cotton markets saw mixed trading on Wednesday with spinners in some places keen to take advantage of the recent dip in New York to book supplies for the rest of this year but sometimes having difficulty finding willing sellers.
Attention in Italy was directed towards Mediterranean new crop cottons and some consideration was also given in that market to Australian styles.
Central Asian descriptions remained uncompetitive. But elsewhere some buyers saw Central Asian prices as more attractive although volumes on offer were thin.
